feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says 'If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands' — a conditional on reaching the exit. The second clause uses Response(at_exit, holding_box), which requires holding_box after any at_exit, but at_exit is a last-step-only condition, so there is never a later step to satisfy it; the machine routes (u0, at_exit&!holding_box) into rejecting state u4 (reward -2), penalizing reaching the exit empty-handed rather than expressing the conditional. Also, the task requires reaching the exit as the goal, yet no Existence(at_exit) clause exists and FINAL_STATES is empty. Fix: make the exit condition a goal clause — hard Existence(at_exit) — and express the requirement with a template whose consequent is checked when at_exit occurs, e.g. NotCoExistence(at_exit, !holding_box) is not available, so use the conditional wording as given: keep a hard clause requiring holding_box whenever the exit is reached (e.g. Response(at_exit, holding_box) replaced by an appropriate last-step formulation the compiler supports) plus a hard Existence(at_exit) so the machine has a final state. As compiled, an agent that never reaches the exit and picks up every fall would look successful, which the task does not allow.
